show.description: “Deal with Billionaire” is a dramatic saga of love, betrayal, and destiny that follows Simran, a humble waitress who unknowingly belongs to a wealthy family. After years of struggle, heartbreak, and deceit, her life changes when she reunites with her four rich brothers and faces powerful enemies, toxic relationships, and a world of greed while fighting to reclaim her identity and self-respect
